faces.name: Defiler of Vigor

effect.reason: No record imposes an optional additional cost on other spells a player casts, nor ties a cost reduction to whether that optional cost was paid. CostModifier can only reduce a spell's cost unconditionally, has no way to say 'you may pay 2 life as an additional cost', and cannot restrict the reduction to the green mana paid.
effect.text: As an additional cost to cast green permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {G} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of green mana you pay.

abilities.text: As an additional cost to cast green permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {G} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of green mana you pay.
Whenever you cast a green permanent spell, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

effect.reason: An optional additional cost imposed on other players' — here, on your own — green permanent spells, with a cost reduction gated on whether that optional cost was actually paid and restricted to the green mana of the cost, has no record: AdditionalCosts is the face's own cost and applies to this spell alone, and CostModifier carries neither an optional-payment gate nor a colour restriction (its only narrowing is genericOnly, which is the opposite of 'only the amount of green mana you pay').
